A dagesh in the tsadi is likely but not clearly visible.
The lamed seems to carry an extra mark that could be a meteg (לַֽעֲדֵי) in some or all seven refrains. Not resolved.
The scan looks like 'Spcaking' and 'Thcrefore', and 'severed' looks like 'severeJ'. I take these as worn type or scan artifacts, not printed misspellings, so no change is proposed.
